name: @ogcio/api-types
description: Layer 3 frontend DTO types generated from each API's committed openapi-definition.yml via openapi-typescript. Nothing here is hand-written.

scripts.codegen: openapi-typescript ../../apps/messaging-api/openapi-definition.yml -o src/messaging.d.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/profile-api/openapi-definition.yml -o src/profile.d.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/upload-api/openapi-definition.yml -o src/upload.d.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/scheduler-api/openapi-definition.yml -o src/scheduler.d.ts
